# GroupDocs.Signature documentation

> On-premise SDK docs for adding, searching, verifying, updating, and deleting electronic signatures (text, image, digital, barcode, QR code, stamp, form field, metadata) in PDF, Microsoft Office, OpenDocument, and image files.
> Platforms: net | java | python-net | nodejs-java | mcp
> .NET TFMs: net462, net6.0, net8.0, net10.0

## Hubs

- https://docs.groupdocs.com/signature/net/
- https://docs.groupdocs.com/signature/java/
- https://docs.groupdocs.com/signature/python-net/
- https://docs.groupdocs.com/signature/nodejs-java/
- https://docs.groupdocs.com/signature/mcp/
